# Resolve song titles to song ids
def find_song_id(title):
    results = []
    page_index = 0
    while True:
        page = apis.spotify.search_songs(query=title, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
        if not page:
            break
        results.extend(page)
        page_index += 1
    exact = [s for s in results if s["title"] == title]
    if exact:
        return exact[0]["song_id"]
    return results[0]["song_id"] if results else None

remove_ids = [find_song_id(t) for t in to_remove_titles]

# Apply updates
